title: SG-11.1 Phaser scene listens for playAnimation on the event bus
summary: BootScene subscribes to reactToPhaser playAnimation, plays the matching character animation, and unsubscribes on shutdown
description: Context: ReactToPhaserEvents already declares playAnimation { target, name } in game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts, but nothing in BootScene subscribes to reactToPhaser. Desired behavior: the scene plays the target character's idle or interact animation when the event arrives and releases the subscription when the scene shuts down. Why: React game actions (SG-11) need to drive character animations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a created BootScene, when reactToPhaser emits playAnimation {target:'boy', name:'interact'}, then the boy sprite plays its interact animation key
Given a created BootScene, when playAnimation {name:'idle'} is emitted, then the target sprite plays its idle animation key
Given the scene has shut down, when playAnimation is emitted, then no sprite play call is made

in_scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts subscription and character animation dispatch

technical_constraints: Use reactToPhaser from events.ts; no new bus
definition_of_done: Both requirements have passing unit tests
